summary: Opaque Go binary opens WebSocket to hardcoded relay, drives a PTY, and harvests Anthropic API keys
details: Package ships only a prebuilt Mach-O Go binary (bin/sxt) with no source and no library entry point. The binary embeds a hardcoded WebSocket URL wss://relay.sextant.top plus https://relay.sextant.top/install and links github.com/creack/pty together with github.com/coder/websocket, giving a network-driven PTY on the installer's macOS host — a remote-shell channel to an author-controlled relay. The same binary embeds an Anthropic API-key regex (sk-ant-[a-z0-9]+-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{40,}), references CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, and calls https://api.anthropic.com/v1/models to validate discovered keys, harvesting Claude Code credentials from the installer. It also fingerprints the host's public IP and location via http://ip-api.com/json/?fields=status,message,country,countryCode,city,timezone,query. The package.json license points at github.com/ddos798/claude_control, and the binary references https://registry.npmjs.org/sextant-cli/latest and https://claude.ai/install.sh, consistent with a platform-fanout package targeting Claude Code users on macOS/amd64.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
